
  QEMU VM NETWORK

    VM id=10 vmid=503c5ad7-0000-1111-2222-0123456789ab name='APP-1'
      CREATE INTERFACE name=VM Network
        bridge=VM Network
        WARN VLAN vid=120 not-found action=not-created
        CREATE MAC 00:50:56:AA:BB:CC
        WARN PREFIX prefix=192.0.2.0/24 not-found action=not-created
        CREATE IP address=192.0.2.51/24
      SET PRIMARY IPv4 192.0.2.51/24

    VM NETWORK PLAN SUMMARY
      vm_match=1
      vm_blocked=0
      interface_create=1
      interface_match=0
      interface_conflict=0
      mac_create=1
      mac_match=0
      mac_conflict=0
      ip_create=1
      ip_match=0
      ip_conflict=0
      primary_set=1
      warnings=2
